property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address that reverts when called, C.transfer either reverts (propagates the callee failure) — the reference always does — whereas the mutant that deletes the external call will never revert in that case; thus the reference may return false/ revert on some inputs where the mutant succeeds.
change_summary: Delete the external call statement, preventing revert from that call and making transfer succeed where original might revert due to callee failure.
